source: What was the reason then…?
translation: 那原因是什么……？

source: I… I’m already content…
translation: 我……我已经满足了……

source: To me, Camp Buddy is already perfect the way it is…
translation: 对我来说，Camp Buddy 现在这样已经很完美了……

source: To start, we’ve received so many amazing chances already and regained what we nearly lost the previous term…
translation: 首先，我们已经得到过许多绝佳的机会，也重新找回了上一期差点失去的东西……

source: Now we’ve made it even bigger in such a short period of time… and to receive yet another opportunity was just so unexpected...
translation: 如今我们在这么短时间内让它变得更大……而又得到一个机会实在太出乎意料……

source: And honestly…. It’s something I don’t aspire for anymore…
translation: 而且说实话……我已经不再追求这个了……

source: Wh-What do you mean…?
translation: 你、你是什么意思……？

source: Don’t get me wrong… I love Camp Buddy with all my heart. It’s my lifelong dream that I had the honor of sharing with everyone, especially you…
translation: 别误会……我全心全意爱着 Camp Buddy。这是我的终生梦想，我有幸和每个人分享，尤其是你……

source: But… I’ve been holding on to this place for so long, believing it’s the only thing that makes all of us happy…
translation: 但是……我坚持这个地方太久了，相信它是唯一能让我们所有人幸福的东西……

source: B-But… I don’t understand… This is what we’ve all been working for.
translation: 但、但是……我不理解……这就是我们大家一直为之努力的东西。

source: It’s just all too sudden… after everything we’ve been through…
translation: 一切都太突然了……在我们经历了这么多之后……

source: What changed…?
translation: 什么变了……？

source: I’m afraid.
translation: 我害怕。

source: O-Of what…?
translation: 害、害怕什么……？

source: I’m afraid of the past repeating itself…
translation: 我害怕过去重演……

source: When I was dealing with all the problems with my ex-wife, I didn’t feel the full extent of the pain because you were there to distract me…
translation: 当我在处理和前妻之间的所有问题时，我没有感受到全部痛苦，因为你在身边分散了我的注意力……

source: Then you left to pursue your dream to become a scoutmaster, and the effects of my divorce finally hit me.
translation: 后来你离开去追寻成为童子军团长的梦想，离婚的影响终于击中了我。

source: The only thing I had left was to try and make Camp Buddy the best it could be…
translation: 我剩下唯一能做的，就是努力让 Camp Buddy 变得尽可能好……

source: I put all my blood, sweat, and tears into it… expanding over and over with blind ambition, until it grew into something I could barely handle…
translation: 我把全部心血都投入其中……盲目地一次次扩张，直到它成长为我几乎无法应付的东西……

source: What I didn’t realize was that I was doing it to cover the pain inside…
translation: 我没有意识到的是，自己这样做是在掩盖内心的痛苦……

source: I tried numbing myself from any emotion, convinced that I had to stay strong and tough, always…
translation: 我试图让自己麻木于任何情绪，相信自己必须永远保持坚强和强硬……

source: I let no one see my weakness, and it started a vicious cycle where I grew more and more bitter each day…
translation: 我不让任何人看到我的软弱，这开始形成恶性循环，让我每天都变得更加苦涩……

source: The dream we had lost all its spirit, turning the camp into a soulless business, and I completely lost touch of what it was supposed to be…
translation: 我们的梦想失去了所有精神，把营地变成没有灵魂的生意，而我完全忘了它本该是什么样子……

source: I… didn’t know you had to go through all that, Goro…
translation: 我……不知道你必须经历这一切，Goro……

source: But still… 	I should’ve respected your right to make your own choice…
translation: 但即便如此……	我本该尊重你做出自己选择的权利……

source: I was taking away an opportunity not only from the camp, but from you… all for my own selfish reasons…
translation: 我夺走的机会不仅属于营地，也属于你……全都只是为了我自私的理由……

source: But I understand, Goro…
translation: 但我理解，Goro……

source: You don’t deserve to suffer like that again, just because we aren’t satisfied with what we have…
translation: 你不该仅仅因为我们不满足于已有的一切，就再次承受那种痛苦……

source: I’ve been sacrificing myself for the camp and everyone else this whole time, but never really pursued my own happiness…
translation: 我一直在为营地和其他所有人牺牲自己，却从未真正追求过自己的幸福……

source: This new opportunity only made me realize that I’m going to commit myself to something beyond my limits again…
translation: 这个新机会只让我意识到，我又要把自己投入超出极限的事情……

source: I just want to move on to a new chapter… And I want you in it…
translation: 我只想走向人生的新篇章……而且我想让你也在其中……

source: Wh-What are you trying to say…?
translation: 你、你想说什么……？

source: After we finish this project… Let’s leave the camp.
translation: 等我们完成这个项目……离开营地吧。

source: We’ve both done so much for a such long time. This is our chance to be happy together…!
translation: 我们两个都已经付出这么久、这么多。这是我们一起幸福的机会……！

source: I-I don’t understand…! There’s no reason why we can’t be together and still stay at the camp!
translation: 我、我不理解……！没有理由说我们不能在一起，同时留在营地！

source: Y-You don’t even have to bear the burden anymore…! You can leave everything up to me!
translation: 你、你甚至不必再承担负担……！你可以把一切交给我！

source: After everything you taught me, I’m ready to lead and make the decisions, so they won’t burden you anymore!
translation: 在你教会我一切之后，我已经准备好领导并做决定，这样它们不会再成为你的负担！

source: We can’t just leave the camp… What’ll happen to everyone else?
translation: 我们不能就这样离开营地……其他人会怎么样？

source: This wasn’t just our dream together, it’s theirs’ too…
translation: 这不只是我们共同的梦想，也是他们的梦想……

source: I know you’re tired, but there must be another way…!
translation: 我知道你累了，但一定还有别的办法……！

source: You’re right…
translation: 你说得对……

source: I shouldn’t make everyone else pay the price just for my own desires…
translation: 我不该只为了自己的愿望，就让其他所有人付出代价……

source: It was unfair and narrow-minded of me to even think like that…
translation: 我竟然会这样想，实在太不公平、太狭隘了……

source: You don’t have to give up on your own happiness and continue with the camp either…
translation: 你也不必放弃自己的幸福、继续留在营地……

source: We’re all here to help… I’m here to help…
translation: 我们都在这里帮你……我也在这里帮你……

source: You can rely on me from now on! Just believe in me!
translation: 从现在起你可以依靠我！只要相信我！

source: I will fulfill my duties until the end of our commitment… and count on you wholeheartedly for the future, Yoshinori…
translation: 我会履行职责直到我们承诺的终点……并在未来全心全意地依靠你，Yoshinori……

source: I’m glad you trust me, Goro… I’m really grateful for everything you’ve done for me and the camp this whole time.
translation: 我很高兴你信任我，Goro……我真的很感激你一直以来为我和营地所做的一切。

source: I promise, you won’t regret it!
translation: 我保证，你不会后悔！

source: {i}After our talk, Goro drove us both home in silence…{/i}
translation: {i}谈完后，Goro 沉默地开车带我们回家……{/i}

source: {i}I can’t believe that I never saw how he was losing heart for the camp… There must be something else that I missed…{/i}
translation: {i}我不敢相信自己从未看出他正在对营地失去信心……一定还有我遗漏的事……{/i}
